# ScanlyFix - AI Optimization Guide

## What We Do
ScanlyFix is a website security, SEO, and AEO scanner that runs 100+ checks and provides AI-ready fix prompts.

## Products
- Security Scanner: Run read-only checks for vulnerabilities
- SEO Scanner: Technical SEO audits
- AEO Scanner: Check AI visibility on ChatGPT, Perplexity
- Uptime Monitoring: 60-second probes with alerts

## API
- REST API: /api/v1 (auth required)
- MCP Server: npx @scanlyfix/mcp-server

## Integrations
- GitHub: Connect for repository scanning
- Supabase: Backend security checks

## Pricing
- Free: Full scans with limited findings
- Pro: $9/month - unlimited scans and monitoring
